# Aseprite test sprites

These `.aseprite` files are from Aseprite's own test suite (`tests/sprites/` in
github.com/aseprite/aseprite), which is released under the MIT license (`LICENSE.txt` here, its
`tests/LICENSE.txt`). Only that folder is MIT; the rest of Aseprite is not, and none of its
program code is used by the engine. `aseprite_test.odin` reads them.
